hooks.command: if [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/activate.py" --host codex; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?}/hooks/activate.py" --host claude; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if defined PLUGIN_ROOT (py -3 "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\hooks\activate.py" --host codex) else (py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\hooks\activate.py" --host claude)
